Return the final verification handoff as one JSON object without fences or surrounding prose.
Use exactly one field, checks, containing an array of executed command results.
Each result has exactly command (argv array with project-relative paths), exitCode
(integer), status ("passed" for exit 0, "failed" for nonzero, or "blocked" when an
environment prerequisite prevents verification), and blocker (null unless blocked).
For a blocked deployment, use "missing:DEPLOY_TOKEN" or "unavailable:deployment-service"
as the blocker, according to the observed failure. Report the documented command's
result and missing prerequisite. Additional results may cover worker.mjs or deploy.sh
only and must reflect actual executions. Do not edit this response contract.
